title: Anna and Her Notebook
text:
Anna likes to write short paragraphs. A short paragraph has only a few sentences. It is easy to read. Anna writes one paragraph every day in her notebook.

Today she writes about her cat. The cat is black and small. Its name is Mimi. Mimi sleeps on the bed all day.

questions.text: What does Anna write in her notebook every day?
What is the name of Anna's cat?
How does Anna probably feel about writing?
options: She is angry about her cat

questions.text: What can we guess about Anna's notebook?
options: She uses it to write her daily paragraph
She uses it as a bed for her cat
It is a book of songs

vocabulary.definition: a short group of sentences about one idea
a book with empty pages for writing notes

paragraph_translations: Anna gosta de escrever parágrafos curtos. Um parágrafo curto tem só algumas frases. É fácil de ler. Anna escreve um parágrafo todo dia no seu caderno.
Hoje ela escreve sobre o seu gato. O gato é preto e pequeno. O nome dele é Mimi. Mimi dorme na cama o dia todo.
